hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE_PATH=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); if [ -n "$FILE_PATH" ] && echo "$FILE_PATH" | grep -qi "\.yaml$\|\.yml$"; then CONTENT=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.content // .tool_input.new_string // empty"); if echo "$CONTENT" | grep -qiE "\b(INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|MERGE|DROP|ALTER|TRUNCATE)\b"; then echo "BLOCKED: Config contains DML/DDL keywords. Snowflake is READ-ONLY." >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; exit 0'
hooks.statusMessage: Validating config has no Snowflake writes...

hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE_PATH=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); if [ -n "$FILE_PATH" ] && echo "$FILE_PATH" | grep -qi "\.py$"; then if command -v flake8 &>/dev/null; then flake8 "$FILE_PATH" --max-line-length=120 --ignore=E501,W503 2>&1 || true; fi; fi; exit 0'
